volume_guardrail: Maximum three social posts, two profile/authority actions, two relationship actions, one editorial asset, one citation pass and one Search Console review.

actions: Verify the Finding Stories LinkedIn account and approve the introduction post.
Record the Search Console Florence status and available impressions, clicks, queries, CTR and position; do not request indexing.
Publish the approved LinkedIn introduction through the authorized account, or retain needs_login.
Verify one relevant editorial publication and contact route.
Tailor one relationship-first partner message to a documented contact; obtain approval before sending.
Verify one moderated directory and its eligibility requirements.
Prepare the location/connectivity LinkedIn post for approval.
Send at most one approved editorial pitch to the verified recipient.
Publish one approved Instagram or LinkedIn asset; do not exceed three social posts this week.
Perform citation verification: only public URLs with complete evidence may be live.
Review attributable sessions, WhatsApp clicks, lead starts/success and qualified enquiries; leave unavailable data null.
